title: Training Lead – Oracle Cloud
description:
Training Lead – Oracle Cloud


  • Data de Início: Imediata
  • Contrato de Trabalho: CLT no cliente da UltraCon
  • Local de Trabalho: Curitiba/PR
  • Modalidade: 100% remoto
  • Horário: Comercial
  • Remuneração: A ser negociado


Descrição da Vaga:


Estamos buscando um Líder de Treinamento – Oracle Cloud, responsável por projetar, entregar e manter programas de treinamento corporativos abrangendo Finanças, Cadeia de Suprimentos, RH, Folha de Pagamento e módulos relacionados do Oracle Cloud. O profissional garantirá a prontidão dos usuários finais, acessibilidade multilíngue e aprendizado contínuo durante todo o ciclo de implementação do ERP.


Esta função exige profundo conhecimento funcional dos módulos Oracle Cloud, expertise em design instrucional e capacidade de atuar em ambientes de transformação em larga escala.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Estratégia e Planejamento de Treinamento

Desenvolver estratégias de treinamento corporativas alinhadas aos marcos da implementação do Oracle Cloud.

Colaborar com líderes funcionais, equipes de Gestão de Mudanças e PMO para definir necessidades de treinamento por função, processo e região.


  • Desenvolvimento e Localização de Conteúdo

Criar materiais de treinamento de alta qualidade, incluindo guias visuais, manuais, módulos eLearning e walkthroughs de processos.

Traduzir e adaptar conteúdos para públicos multilíngues (Português/Inglês), garantindo clareza, acessibilidade e inclusão.


  • Entrega e Facilitação

Conduzir sessões de treinamento presenciais e virtuais (ILT) para usuários-chave, unidades de negócio e equipes de suporte.

Liderar programas de capacitação de instrutores (Train-the-Trainer), desenvolvendo capacidade interna para aprendizado contínuo no pós-go-live.


  • Engajamento com Stakeholders

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com RH, TI e líderes de negócio para garantir adoção, alinhamento e ciclos de feedback.

Apoiar atividades de onboarding, reforço pós-implementação e habilitação contínua dos usuários.


  • Ferramentas e Tecnologia

Utilizar Oracle UPK, WalkMe, plataformas LMS e ferramentas digitais de aprendizagem para melhorar os resultados.

Manter repositórios estruturados de treinamento e modelos de controle de versão para cada área funcional.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em treinamento ERP, preferencialmente com Oracle Cloud (Financeiro, SCM, HCM)/ Oracle Apps / ERP Finance, Gestão da Cadeia de Suprimentos, RH & Folha de Pagamento – Treinamento Funcional
  • Sucesso comprovado na liderança de programas de treinamento em iniciativas de transformação corporativa ou migração para nuvem.
  • Forte habilidade em design instrucional e comunicação visual.
  • Experiência com adaptação de treinamentos multilíngues e documentação acessível.
  • Excelentes habilidades de facilitação, coaching e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Certificações desejáveis: PMP, Prosci, credenciais Oracle Cloud.
  • Inglês Avançado (Mandatório)


Competências Comportamentais:


  • Comunicação excepcional para ministrar treinamentos a grupos diversos.
  • Forte capacidade organizacional para gerenciar conteúdos, cronogramas e expectativas dos stakeholders.
  • Alta atenção aos detalhes em documentação, materiais instrucionais e fluxos de aprendizagem.
  • Empatia e foco no usuário ao apoiar diferentes estilos de aprendizado e níveis de prontidão.
  • Proatividade e colaboração, promovendo alinhamento com equipes funcionais e técnicas.
  • Adaptabilidade às fases evolutivas da implementação, mudanças de processos e melhorias orientadas por feedback.
  • Presença de liderança para orientar instrutores, usuários-chave e stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de resolução de problemas para suprir lacunas de aprendizado e apoiar desafios de adoção.


Mais informações serão fornecidas durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Training Lead – Oracle Cloud
description:
Training Lead – Oracle Cloud


  • Data de Início: Imediata
  • Contrato de Trabalho: CLT no cliente da UltraCon
  • Local de Trabalho: Curitiba/PR
  • Modalidade: 100% remoto
  • Horário: Comercial
  • Remuneração: A ser negociado


Descrição da Vaga:


Estamos buscando um Líder de Treinamento – Oracle Cloud, responsável por projetar, entregar e manter programas de treinamento corporativos abrangendo Finanças, Cadeia de Suprimentos, RH, Folha de Pagamento e módulos relacionados do Oracle Cloud. O profissional garantirá a prontidão dos usuários finais, acessibilidade multilíngue e aprendizado contínuo durante todo o ciclo de implementação do ERP.


Esta função exige profundo conhecimento funcional dos módulos Oracle Cloud, expertise em design instrucional e capacidade de atuar em ambientes de transformação em larga escala.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Estratégia e Planejamento de Treinamento

Desenvolver estratégias de treinamento corporativas alinhadas aos marcos da implementação do Oracle Cloud.

Colaborar com líderes funcionais, equipes de Gestão de Mudanças e PMO para definir necessidades de treinamento por função, processo e região.


  • Desenvolvimento e Localização de Conteúdo

Criar materiais de treinamento de alta qualidade, incluindo guias visuais, manuais, módulos eLearning e walkthroughs de processos.

Traduzir e adaptar conteúdos para públicos multilíngues (Português/Inglês), garantindo clareza, acessibilidade e inclusão.


  • Entrega e Facilitação

Conduzir sessões de treinamento presenciais e virtuais (ILT) para usuários-chave, unidades de negócio e equipes de suporte.

Liderar programas de capacitação de instrutores (Train-the-Trainer), desenvolvendo capacidade interna para aprendizado contínuo no pós-go-live.


  • Engajamento com Stakeholders

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com RH, TI e líderes de negócio para garantir adoção, alinhamento e ciclos de feedback.

Apoiar atividades de onboarding, reforço pós-implementação e habilitação contínua dos usuários.


  • Ferramentas e Tecnologia

Utilizar Oracle UPK, WalkMe, plataformas LMS e ferramentas digitais de aprendizagem para melhorar os resultados.

Manter repositórios estruturados de treinamento e modelos de controle de versão para cada área funcional.

  • Experiência em treinamento ERP, preferencialmente com Oracle Cloud (Financeiro, SCM, HCM)/ Oracle Apps / ERP Finance, Gestão da Cadeia de Suprimentos, RH & Folha de Pagamento – Treinamento Funcional

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: Account Manager (Adtech)
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About Us

Orange Storm is a venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA and Barcelona, Spain. We provide an integrated ecosystem—including a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and AI-driven analytics platform—to help publishers and advertisers drive higher revenue and smarter decisions.

Our global, diverse team is our greatest asset. With a culture rooted in trust, ownership, and continuous learning, we empower talent to grow, experiment, and deliver real-world impact. We are proud of our collaborative spirit, agile execution, and commitment to building scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the ever-evolving AdTech landscape.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a high-performing Account Manager to manage and expand relationships with our advertising clients across the APAC region, including direct advertisers and agencies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end client relationships, ensuring successful campaign delivery, optimization, and KPI achievement.
  • Develop and implement advertising strategies to drive client ROI and campaign performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (operations, product, tech) to ensure smooth execution and timely issue resolution.
  • Provide clients with regular data analysis, performance reports, and actionable insights.
  • Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Stay informed about APAC advertising market trends and competitive landscape.


Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, or mobile marketing as an Account Manager or Customer Success Manager.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of advertising operations, SDKs, attribution platforms like Appsflyer or Adjust, and fraud prevention.
  • Strong project management, client servicing, and communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to optimization.
  • Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple accounts remotely across time zones.


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Attractive and competitive pay and Performance Bonus + Uncapped Revenue Commission!
  • Annual Leave: 20 working days paid leave per year (pro-rated) + local public holidays
  • Remote Work: Fully remote with reasonable overlap hours; occasional travel budget if needed
  • And many more!


Orange Storm is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity at all levels of the organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors.


We truly appreciate the time and effort every candidate puts into applying to Orange Storm. While we carefully review each application, due to the high volume of interest we receive, we’re unfortunately unable to respond to every individual submission. If your profile aligns with the role and we decide to move forward, a member of our team will reach out to you directly. We thank you in advance for your understanding and for considering a career with us.

Our global, diverse team is our greatest asset. With a culture rooted in trust, ownership, and continuous learning, we empower talent to grow, experiment, and deliver real-world impact. We are proud of our collaborative spirit, agile execution, and commitment to building scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the ever-evolving AdTech landscape.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a high-performing Account Manager to manage and expand relationships with our advertising clients across the APAC region, including direct advertisers and agencies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end client relationships, ensuring successful campaign delivery, optimization, and KPI achievement.
  • Develop and implement advertising strategies to drive client ROI and campaign performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (operations, product, tech) to ensure smooth execution and timely issue resolution.
  • Provide clients with regular data analysis, performance reports, and actionable insights.
  • Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Stay informed about APAC advertising market trends and competitive landscape.


Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, or mobile marketing as an Account Manager or Customer Success Manager.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of advertising operations, SDKs, attribution platforms like Appsflyer or Adjust, and fraud prevention.
  • Strong project management, client servicing, and communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to optimization.
  • Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple accounts remotely across time zones.


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Attractive and competitive pay and Performance Bonus + Uncapped Revenue Commission!
  • Annual Leave: 20 working days paid leave per year (pro-rated) + local public holidays
  • Remote Work: Fully remote with reasonable overlap hours; occasional travel budget if needed
  • And many more!


Orange Storm is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity at all levels of the organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors.


We truly appreciate the time and effort every candidate puts into applying to Orange Storm. While we carefully review each application, due to the high volume of interest we receive, we’re unfortunately unable to respond to every individual submission. If your profile aligns with the role and we decide to move forward, a member of our team will reach out to you directly. We thank you in advance for your understanding and for considering a career with us.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, etc.);
  • Boas práticas de segurança e qualidade de código;
  • Atuação em metodologias ágeis.


Seu papel será:

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

description:

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
Descrição do perfil

Responsável por analisar e interpretar grandes quantidades de dados de uma variedade de fontes, usando ferramentas algorítmicas, de mineração de dados, inteligência artificial, aprendizado de máquina e estatísticas, a fim de torná-los acessíveis à empresa.



Principais atividades

- Identificar, coletar, preparar, validar, analisar e interpretar dados relativos às várias atividades da organização para extrair informações, inclusive através do desenvolvimento de modelos preditivos e estatísticos para gerar sistemas avançados de aprendizagem e conhecimento organizado;

- Identificar e acessar as fontes de dados capazes de apoiar e desenvolver um determinado processo de negócios;

- Desenvolver protótipos e proof of concept em projetos de inovação utilizando ferramentas de desenvolvimento ágil;

- Supervisionar a inovação tecnológica e promover a sua aplicação através da elaboração de relatórios de prospecção tecnológica e análise de oportunidades, destacando as alternativas;

- Definir e aplicar modelos de análise de dados descritivos, preditivos e prescritivos com base nas necessidades de aplicação definidas;

- Identificar interpretar e manipular os conjuntos de dados necessários para o desenvolvimento dos modelos;

- Promover a aplicação de técnicas de aprendizado de máquina estatísticas corretas;

- Contribuir na disseminação de uma cultura de Data-Driven Decision na cia, fazendo interface entre áreas técnicas e as diversas áreas de negócio;

- Extrair e organizar dados de inúmeras fontes e transformá-los em informações úteis e decifráveis por meio de gráficos e dashboards.



Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

- Codificação de programas e aplicações

- Algoritmos de Machine learning e frameworks como: TensorFlow, Pytorch, Sci-Kit Learn, Keras, H2O etc);

- Linguagens de programação (SQL, Shell Script, R, Pyhton, Scala, Java, etc.)

- Data Mining

- Database management

- Conhecimento de soluções de dados em Cloud (GCP, Azure, OCI, etc)

- Ensino superior completo

description:
AI Gateway Engineer

We are seeking a skilled AI Gateway Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AI or API gateways, a strong background in backend development, and expertise in deploying and optimizing AI/ML models in a production environment. You will be instrumental in building and scaling our AI infrastructure within an enterprise-grade setting.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and manage AI/API gateways like Kong, Mosaic, or Portkey.
  • Develop and maintain backend services, primarily using Go , with Python as a valuable secondary skill.
  • Optimize and productize AI/ML models for production use, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Leverage AWS to build and manage our cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage observability tools, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), Grafana, and Prometheus , to monitor system health and performance.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of AI models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Proven experience with API or AI gateways (e.g., Kong, Mosaic, Portkey).
  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Go ; proficiency in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with AI/ML optimization and productization .
  • Expertise in AWS , including its various services for building scalable applications.
  • Familiarity with observability tools like OTel, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering .
  • A history of working in enterprise-grade environments .


Other Details:
  • Location: Remote (preferred in LATAM region)
  • Length: 1+ Year
  • Client: Gaming Giant

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Auxiliar de logística
description:
Principais tarefas:

  • Recebimento, conferência e organização de materiais de mármore e granito.
  • Gestão de estoque, realizando controle e reposição de materiais.
  • Movimentação interna de cargas, auxiliando na preparação de pedidos.
  • Carga, descarga e transporte de materiais, com foco na segurança e eficiência.
  • Realização de entregas aos clientes, garantindo pontualidade, integridade dos produtos e satisfação.
  • Apoio na preparação e cortes de materiais, quando necessário.
  • Comunicação efetiva com a equipe e clientes para garantir um fluxo de trabalho eficiente.

Requisitos:

  • Mínimo de 25 anos, com experiência anterior na área de logística, preferencialmente em empresas que lidam com materiais pesados ou de alto valor.
  • Conhecimento na operação de transporte e armazenamento de materiais de grande porte.
  • Responsável, proativo e com bom relacionamento interpessoal.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.


What you will do :

  • Develop responsive and elegant web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and improve data flow.
  • Translate design mockups into reusable and scalable components.
  • Continuously optimize applications for performance and accessibility.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and a great user experience on all devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to the team’s technical growth.


What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior - Foco Java


Requisitos para vaga:

  • Formação de nível superior na área de informática ou pós-graduação em TI com duração mínima de 360 horas;
  • Experiência desempenhando funções de desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando tecnologias JAVA e de 03 (três) anos como Desenvolvedor Sênior.
  • Possuir 1(uma) certificação dentre as listadas abaixo:

SUN Certified Java Programmer (SCJP) ou equivalente, emitido pela Sun Microsystems ou pela Oracle;

Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 8 Programmer ou equivalente, emitido pela Oracle;

Oracle Certified Professional Java SE 11 Developer ou equivalente, emitido pela Oracle;

Oracle Java SE 17 Developer.

  • Experiência nas seguintes tecnologias e processos:
  • Angular e REST;
  • HTML 5 e CSS;
  • Hibernate;
  • Service-Oriented Architecture – SOA e desenvolvimento de web services;
  • Servidor de aplicações JBoss;
  • Openshift ou Kubernetes;
  • Maven/Jenkins (Geração/Automatização de builds);
  • Sonar (Validação de builds);
  • Controle de versões com GIT
  • Elastic
  • kafka
  • quarkus
  • Desejável Conhecimentos:
  • padrões de projeto (Design Patterns);
  • Openshift/Kubernetes;
  • DevOps/DevSecOps;
  • Test Driven Development – TDD e Behavior Driven Development – BDD.
  • Métricas de qualidade de código;
  • Técnicas para construção de software seguro;
  • Método Ágil Scrum.

Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.

SEGW/oData

title: Consultor SAP MM/WM (AMS)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:

  • Consultor(a) para compor o time de AMS da NTT DATA realizando atendimento de chamados de sustentação e melhorias nos módulos MM/WM.


Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior Completo
  • Experiência como Consultor Pleno MM e WM.
  • Desejável conhecimento do EWM.
  • Experiência com implementação e/ou suporte AMS.
  • Inglês Avançado - Desejável


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Tipo de contrato: CLT


Garantimos que nossos funcionários sejam bem tratados, oferecendo pacotes de remuneração específicos para cada país, programas de reconhecimento e benefícios de prevenção. Dessa forma, incentivamos nossos colaboradores a terem o melhor desempenho e a comemorarem suas conquistas.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: Analista Sênior De Projetos De Serviços
description:
Sobre a empresa

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Acreditamos no poder transformador da tecnologia e na sua capacidade de contribuir para a construção de uma sociedade mais diversa e inclusiva. Por isso, temos compromisso com nossa política e programa de diversidade e inclusão para garantirmos um ecossistema cada vez mais representativo, respeitoso e acolhedor.


#ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS


Descrição da vaga

Responsável pela condução de projetos de implantação/evolução junto ao cliente, visando assegurar a qualidade e o sucesso da implantação, reunindo os recursos necessários para cumprir os prazos e entregas junto ao cliente

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir projetos de alta complexidade e alto volume de horas, com personalização e de clientes estratégicos;
  • Inovar e criar novos processos que aumentem a eficiência dos projetos;
  • Construir indicadores relevantes para a área, com objetivo de identificar oportunidades, gerar insights e auxiliar na tomada de decisão;
  • Mentorar TOTVERS com menos conhecimento sobre a aplicação de métodos e processos da área de projetos e ferramentas;
  • Ser ponto focal, para clientes e áreas internas repassando dados e informações por meio de e-mails, calls/reuniões e registros em sistema;
  • Identificar os riscos do projetos sob sua responsabilidade, registrando em sistema;
  • Garantir a assiduidade do apontamento das horas em projetos sob sua responsabilidade de todos os recursos alocados;
  • Planejar e alocar os recursos envolvidos no projeto;
  • Garantir o faturamento em tempo correto dos projetos de serviços, conforme contratação realizada pelo cliente junto à proposta comercial;
  • Garantir a rentabilidade financeira dos projetos de serviços sob sua responsabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Graduação completa em Administração, estatística, Tecnologia da Informação, engenharias, economia, Marketing ou áreas afins. Pós graduação em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão comercial ou gestão empresarial.
  • Conhecimentos específicos: Pacote Office - Excel, Conhecimento teórico das ferramentas e filosofias de projeto.
  • Experiência: Desejável vivência profissional em condução de projetos ou especialização em gestão de projetos

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Organização e gestão de prioridades
  • Comunicação eficaz (oral e escrita)
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em processos
  • Proatividade e atitude de dono
  • Relacionamento interpessoal e empatia
  • Resiliência e estabilidade emocional
  • Senso de urgência e comprometimento com entregas
  • Escuta ativa e entendimento de contexto


CLT

Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

title: Consultor SAP MM/WM (AMS)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:

  • Consultor(a) para compor o time de AMS da NTT DATA realizando atendimento de chamados de sustentação e melhorias nos módulos MM/WM.


Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior Completo
  • Experiência como Consultor Pleno MM e WM.
  • Desejável conhecimento do EWM.
  • Experiência com implementação e/ou suporte AMS.
  • Inglês Avançado - Desejável


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Tipo de contrato: CLT


Garantimos que nossos funcionários sejam bem tratados, oferecendo pacotes de remuneração específicos para cada país, programas de reconhecimento e benefícios de prevenção. Dessa forma, incentivamos nossos colaboradores a terem o melhor desempenho e a comemorarem suas conquistas.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Assistente de compras
description:
Título da Vaga: Assistente de Compras

Resumo da Função:

Profissional responsável pelo suporte ao processo de compras, com foco na cotação, negociação e aquisição de passagens aéreas e hospedagens, assegurando o melhor custo-benefício e o cumprimento das políticas internas da empresa.

Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar cotações de passagens aéreas e reservas de hotel para colaboradores em deslocamento.
  • Negociar valores, prazos e condições com fornecedores, buscando otimização de custos.
  • Emitir solicitações de compra e acompanhar todo o fluxo até o faturamento.
  • Manter controle e registro das viagens corporativas em planilhas/sistemas internos.
  • Avaliar e homologar novos fornecedores quando necessário.
  • Garantir que todas as contratações estejam alinhadas às políticas internas da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia na área de compras, preferencialmente com foco em viagens corporativas.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão (ERP) e Excel intermediário.
  • Boa capacidade de negociação e organização.
  • Perfil proativo, atento aos detalhes e com boa comunicação.

Desejável:

  • Vivência em empresas de médio ou grande porte.
  • Experiência com agências de viagem corporativa.

title: Analista Citrix Pleno
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Buscamos um Analista Citrix Pleno para desempenhar atividades relacionadas à administração, suporte e otimização de ambientes Citrix.


Sobre a vaga

  • Modalidade: Híbirdo (presencial 2x na semana - São Paulo, Jabaquara).
  • Horário: segunda a sexta das 08:00 às 17:00.


Atividades

  • Administração de ambientes Citrix (XenApp, XenDesktop), incluindo instalação, configuração e atualizações.
  • Suporte técnico de nível 2 e 3 para usuários e times internos.
  • Monitoramento de performance e resolução de problemas.
  • Documentação técnica e de processos.
  • Implementação de políticas de segurança no ambiente Citrix.
  • Colaboração com outras áreas de TI (redes, servidores, suporte).
  • Treinamento e capacitação de usuários e equipes.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida (presencial 2x por semana).
  • Inglês básico para comunicação escrita (cliente multinacional).


Benefícios

✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Vale transporte

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Trabalho remoto para gestantes

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Day off no seu aniversário

✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

✓ Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)

✓ Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)


Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

description:

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Descrição da vaga

Responsável pela condução de projetos de implantação/evolução junto ao cliente, visando assegurar a qualidade e o sucesso da implantação, reunindo os recursos necessários para cumprir os prazos e entregas junto ao cliente

  • Conduzir projetos de alta complexidade e alto volume de horas, com personalização e de clientes estratégicos;

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!
